sentences.zh: 嗨，我是安德鲁·罗斯·索尔金。

sentences.zh: 我负责《纽约时报》每日简报 Dealbook 的商业与政策报道。

sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》。

sentences.zh: 11月18日，我将在纽约市 Dealbook 峰会的舞台上，现场采访商业、政治和文化领域最具影响力的领袖，包括 J.D.

sentences.en: Vance, Elon Musk, Christine
sentences.zh: 万斯、埃隆·马斯克、克里斯蒂娜

sentences.en: Lagarde, Zylran Mondani, and many others, live on stage at the Dealbook Summit in New York City.
sentences.zh: 拉加德、齐尔兰·蒙达尼以及许多其他人。

sentences.zh: 你可以直接观看其中一些毫无防备、未经过滤的真实对话。

sentences.zh: 我们将于 11 月 18 日在 nytimes.com 上直播部分精选访谈，供任何人免费观看。

sentences.zh: 希望你会收看。

sentences.zh: 你一定不想错过。

sentences.en: From the New York Times, I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是来自《纽约时报》的迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这里是《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: Today.
sentences.zh: 今天。

sentences.en: Last week, Democratic House Leader Nancy Pelosi took the floor for eight hours to protest against a
sentences.zh: 上周，民主党众议院领袖南希·佩洛西在议会发表了长达八小时的演讲，抗议一项

sentences.en: spending bill that she now says she wanted her Democratic colleagues to vote for.
sentences.zh: 她现在说自己其实希望民主党同僚投票支持的支出法案。

sentences.en: What that tells us about the state of the Democratic Party.
sentences.zh: 这向我们透露了民主党现状的什么信息。

sentences.en: It's Tuesday, February 13th.
sentences.zh: 今天是2月13日，星期二。

sentences.en: I yield one minute to Leader Pelosi.
sentences.zh: 我让出一分钟给佩洛西领袖。

sentences.en: Last Wednesday, Nancy Pelosi, the Democratic leader of the House, walks onto the House floor.
sentences.zh: 上周三，众议院民主党领袖南希·佩洛西走上了众议院大厅。

sentences.en: The general lady is recognized for one minute.
sentences.zh: 这位女士获得了一分钟发言时间。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: Thank you, Mr. Speaker.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，议长先生。

sentences.en: I thank the general lady for yielding and congratulate her on her And she's going to take advantage of a procedural rule they have called the Magic Minute.
sentences.zh: 我感谢这位女士的让步，并祝贺她……她将利用他们称之为“神奇一分钟”的程序规则。

sentences.en: Cheryl Gay Stolbrook covers Congress for the Times.
sentences.zh: 谢丽尔·盖伊·斯托尔布鲁克为《时报》报道国会新闻。
zh_words: 谢丽尔·盖伊·斯托尔布鲁克

sentences.en: Under the Magic Minute, there are only three people in the House, the Speaker, the Republican leader, and the Democratic leader, who can speak for as long as they want.
sentences.zh: 根据“神奇一分钟”规则，众议院里只有三个人——议长、共和党领袖和民主党领袖——可以想讲多久就讲多久。

sentences.en: And Nancy Pelosi is now taking advantage of this rule.
sentences.zh: 而南希·佩洛西现在正在利用这项规则。

sentences.en: And she's up at the lectern, and she starts talking about the dreamers.
sentences.zh: 她站在讲台前，开始谈论追梦人。

sentences.en: Mr. Speaker, this debate is an utter waste of time.
sentences.zh: 议长先生，这场辩论完全是在浪费时间。

sentences.en: Every day, courageous, patriotic dreamers lose their status.
sentences.zh: 每一天，勇敢、爱国的追梦人都在失去他们的身份。

sentences.en: Every day, the American dream slips further out of reach.
sentences.zh: 每一天，美国梦都离我们越来越远。

sentences.en: Members of Congress are trustees of the people and of our nation.
sentences.zh: 国会议员是人民和我们国家的托管人。

sentences.en: Why are we here if not to protect the patriotic young people who are determined to contribute and to strengthen America?
sentences.zh: 如果我们不是为了保护那些决心为美国做贡献、壮大美国的爱国青年，我们为什么会在这里？

sentences.en: So I'm going to go on as long as my leadership minute allows.
sentences.zh: 因此，只要我的领导发言时间允许，我就会一直讲下去。

sentences.en: But she doesn't just talk about them.
sentences.zh: 但她不只是在谈论他们。

sentences.en: She's reading letters from them.
sentences.zh: 她在宣读他们的信件。

sentences.en: I'm going to talk about Luis Galvin.
sentences.zh: 我要谈谈路易斯·加尔文。

sentences.en: Luis Galvin.
sentences.zh: 路易斯·加尔文。

sentences.en: Luis came to the United States when he was five years old and grew up in poverty.
sentences.zh: 路易斯五岁时来到美国，在贫困中长大。

sentences.en: Itzel Verduzco Rojas is from Ponca City, Oklahoma.
sentences.zh: 伊策尔·贝尔杜斯科·罗哈斯来自俄克拉荷马州庞卡城。

sentences.en: Itzel is working as a medical assistant for a pediatric dermatologist and in school full-time trying to pursue a career in nursing.
sentences.zh: 伊策尔在一家小儿皮肤科医生诊所做医疗助理，同时全职上学，追求护理职业。

sentences.en: Cesar Vargas was born in Mexico, holds a law degree, and wants to become a military lawyer.
sentences.zh: 凯萨·瓦加斯出生于墨西哥，拥有法律学位，并希望成为一名军事律师。

sentences.en: She's reading one statement after another, after another.
sentences.zh: 她一份接一份、不断地宣读着声明。

sentences.en: Salia writes,
sentences.zh: 萨利亚写道：

sentences.en: We still don't know a lot about cancer.
sentences.zh: 我们对癌症仍然知之甚少。

sentences.en: We still don't know about genetic diseases.
sentences.zh: 我们对遗传病仍然知之甚少。

sentences.en: My research at
sentences.zh: 我在

sentences.en: Texas Tech goes right to the heart of that.
sentences.zh: 德克萨斯理工大学的研究直指问题的核心。

sentences.en: Proud to be from the South, and I love to give back to my community.
sentences.zh: 我很自豪来自南方，我热爱回馈我的社区。

sentences.en: My last year at Southern Methodist University, I began working on an engaged learning fellowship.
sentences.zh: 我在南卫理公会大学的最后一年，开始参与一项契合式学习奖学金项目。

sentences.en: Because of that, I was selected to be the commencement speaker for my graduation.
sentences.zh: 正因为如此，我被选为我那一届毕业典礼的发言人。

sentences.en: Nancy Pelosi is talking, and she's talking, and she's talking.
sentences.zh: 南希·佩洛西在说，一直在说，不停地说。

sentences.en: You know, she's standing there in her four-inch heels and just going on and on and on for hours.
sentences.zh: 你知道，她脚踩四英寸的高跟鞋站在那里，就这样没完没了地讲了几个小时。

sentences.en: At about roughly the six-hour mark, she reads a note from the House historian.
sentences.zh: 在大约第六个小时左右，她宣读了一张来自众议院历史学家的便条。

sentences.en: I just got word that the House historian confirms you have now set the record for the longest continuous speech in the House since at least 1909.
sentences.zh: 我刚刚接到消息，众议院历史学家证实，你现在创下了自 1909 年以来众议院最长连续演讲的纪录。

sentences.en: She's passed the longest-running speech on the House floor.
sentences.zh: 她打破了众议院历史上持续时间最长的演讲记录。

sentences.en: I wonder what that was.
sentences.zh: 我想知道那是什么时候。

sentences.en: Which was in 1909.
It just really was a remarkable feat.
sentences.zh: 这确实是一个了不起的壮举。

sentences.en: I mean, the one thing she could not do was say, I yield the floor.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，她唯一不能做的事情就是说：“我放弃发言权。”

sentences.en: She did not sit down.
sentences.zh: 她没有坐下。

sentences.en: She did not take a drink of water that I saw.
sentences.zh: 据我所见，她没有喝一口水。

sentences.en: She certainly didn't go to the restroom because she couldn't leave.
sentences.zh: 她当然也没有去洗手间，因为她不能离开。

sentences.en: And Cheryl, why did Nancy Pelosi decide to tell all these stories on the House floor last Wednesday?
sentences.zh: 谢丽尔，为什么南希·佩洛西上周三决定在众议院讲述所有这些故事？

sentences.en: So Nancy Pelosi had made a commitment to these DREAMers that their fate would be attached to a must-pass spending bill in the House.
sentences.zh: 所以南希·佩洛西曾向这些“追梦人”承诺，他们的命运将与众议院一项必须通过的支出法案捆绑在一起。

sentences.en: As Nancy Pelosi was speaking, the clock was ticking toward a midnight deadline when funding for the government was about to run out.
sentences.zh: 正当南希·佩洛西发表讲话时，距离政府资金即将耗尽的午夜死线正一分一秒地逼近。

sentences.en: She was basically trying to extract a promise from the House Speaker that he would commit to a vote
sentences.zh: 她基本上是试图从众议院议长那里得到一个承诺，即他承诺进行投票

sentences.en: on these DREAMers in exchange for passage of the bill that was going to keep the government open.
sentences.zh: 关于这些追梦人，作为交换条件，通过旨在保持政府运作的法案。

sentences.en: So what Pelosi is doing here is saying, I will not support this spending bill that will keep the government funded and open.
sentences.zh: 所以佩洛西在这里所做的是在说：我不会支持这项维持政府资金和运作的支出法案。

sentences.en: And I will discourage my fellow Democrats from doing the same unless DACA is fixed, unless I'm assured that there will be a vote on it pretty much immediately.
sentences.zh: 除非DACA得到解决，除非我确信几乎会立即对其进行投票，否则我会阻止我的民主党同僚这样做。

sentences.en: She's linking these two things.
sentences.zh: 她将这两件事联系在了一起。

sentences.en: That's absolutely right.
sentences.zh: 完全正确。

sentences.en: To lean on Paul Ryan, the Speaker, to do what Mitch McConnell, the Senate Republican leader, has said he will do, which is schedule a free and open debate on DACA.
sentences.zh: 向众议院议长保罗·瑞安施压，让他去做参议院共和党领袖米奇·麦康奈尔已经说过他会做的事，那就是安排一场关于 DACA 的自由且公开的辩论。

sentences.en: Honor the House of Representatives.
sentences.zh: 维护众议院的尊严。

sentences.en: Give us a chance to have it vote on the floor.
sentences.zh: 给我们一个在议会进行投票的机会。

sentences.en: The Republican leader in the Senate, the Republican leader, Mitch McConnell, has gone forward with the promise that he will give that opportunity to floor the Senate.
sentences.zh: 参议院共和党领袖，共和党领袖米奇·麦康奈尔已经承诺，他将把这个机会带到参议院进行辩论。

sentences.en: The Senate will work its will.
sentences.zh: 参议院将按其意愿行事。

sentences.en: We'll see what they produce.
sentences.zh: 我们将看看他们会产出什么结果。

sentences.en: And we'll work our will here and see what we produce.
sentences.zh: 我们也将在这里按我们的意愿行事，看看我们能产出什么结果。

sentences.en: So her message to fellow Democrats, perhaps unspoken, is follow me.
sentences.zh: 因此，她对同僚民主党人发出的信息，或许没有明说，就是：跟我来。

sentences.en: Go along with what she was doing to try to block this spending bill, to force the hand of Paul Ryan, the Speaker, to give them the vote on the Dreamers that they wanted.
sentences.zh: 顺从她的做法，试图阻止这项支出法案，迫使众议院议长保罗·瑞安妥协，给他们想要的关于追梦人的投票。

sentences.en: But most of all, let us thank and acknowledge the Dreamers for their courage, their optimism, their inspiration to make America more American.
sentences.zh: 但最重要的是，让我们感谢并承认追梦人的勇气、他们的乐观精神、以及他们让美国变得更美国的启发力量。

sentences.en: Thank you, my colleague.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，我的同僚。

sentences.en: Cheryl, had you ever seen anything like that before in the House?
sentences.zh: 谢丽尔，你以前在众议院见过这样的事情吗？

sentences.en: No, absolutely not.
sentences.zh: 不，绝对没有。

sentences.en: And I don't think anyone who works there has.
sentences.zh: 而且我认为任何在那里工作的人都没有见过。

sentences.en: I mean, the last time this happened was in 1909.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，上一次发生这种事还是在 1909 年。

sentences.en: So after all of this talking, eight hours worth of talking about Nancy Pelosi, what happens?
sentences.zh: 所以在说了这一切之后，南希·佩洛西进行了长达八小时的讲话，结果怎么样？

sentences.en: After all this, Paul Ryan doesn't give his commitment.
sentences.zh: 在这一切之后，保罗·瑞安并没有给出他的承诺。

sentences.en: And a majority of Republicans vote in favor of the spending bill, but not enough Republicans to pass it.
sentences.zh: 多数共和党人投票赞成该支出法案，但赞成人数不足以使其通过。

sentences.en: So they need Democrats.
sentences.zh: 所以他们需要民主党人。

sentences.en: Democrats.
sentences.zh: 民主党人。

sentences.en: And Nancy Pelosi had 73 defections.
sentences.zh: 而南希·佩洛西有 73 人反水。

sentences.en: 73 Democrats voted in favor of this spending bill.
sentences.zh: 73名民主党人投票赞成这项支出法案。

sentences.en: So Cheryl, this looks like a pretty significant failure for Nancy Pelosi, especially after this epic speech on the floor.
sentences.zh: 所以谢丽尔，这看起来像是南希·佩洛西的一个重大失败，尤其是在这场史诗般的议会演讲之后。

sentences.en: Yeah, it certainly looks like a failure.
sentences.zh: 是的，这看起来确实像是一次失败。

sentences.en: But afterwards, I sat down with Nancy Pelosi, and she told me quite the opposite, that she wanted this bill to pass.
sentences.zh: 但事后，我和南希·佩洛西坐下来谈了谈，她告诉我完全相反的事情，说她其实希望这项法案通过。

sentences.en: Of course I wanted to pass.
sentences.zh: 我当然希望它通过。

sentences.en: But I did want the Speaker to give us a commitment, but she still hasn't.
sentences.zh: 但我确实希望议长能给我们一个承诺，但他至今还没有给。

sentences.en: Of course I wanted the bill to pass.
sentences.zh: 我当然希望法案通过。

sentences.en: We got everything we wanted.
sentences.zh: 我们得到了我们想要的一切。

sentences.en: So would you call it a win for Democrats, what happened this week?
sentences.zh: 那么你会把本周发生的事情称为民主党人的胜利吗？

sentences.en: I think the bill was a win for Democrats.
sentences.zh: 我认为该法案对民主党人来说是一场胜利。

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 绝对是的。

sentences.en: I think the Republicans gave away the store.
sentences.zh: 我认为共和党人把一切都拱手相让了。

sentences.en: I think it was a tremendous win for Democrats.
sentences.zh: 我认为这对民主党人来说是一场巨大的胜利。

sentences.en: I was kind of struck that she said, of course I wanted it to pass.
sentences.zh: 她说过“我当然希望它通过”，这让我有点震撼。

sentences.en: So I wondered, 73 Democrats voted for the bill.
sentences.zh: 所以我很好奇，有 73 名民主党人投票赞成该法案。

sentences.en: Is that a loss for you?
sentences.zh: 这对你来说是失败吗？

sentences.en: No, no.
sentences.zh: 不，不。

sentences.en: I don't think those people are not in support of the Dreamers.
sentences.zh: 我不认为这些人不支持追梦人。

sentences.en: I think they just, we made the bill too good.
sentences.zh: 我想他们只是……我们把法案做得太好了。

sentences.en: But I would do that again.
sentences.zh: 但我还是会这么做。

sentences.en: In other words, in making the bill as good as it was, and actually the Republicans yielded on everything and got everything.
sentences.zh: 换句话说，由于把法案做得如此之好，而且实际上共和党人在各方面都做出了让步并满足了所有要求。

sentences.en: So when the bill is so good and it meets our priorities, they weigh the equities, go that route, but without any saying,
sentences.zh: 所以当法案如此完美且符合我们的优先事项时，他们权衡了各方利益，选择了那条路，但并没有人说：

sentences.en: I'm not voting for the Dreamers.
sentences.zh: “我不为追梦人投票。”

sentences.en: So we have a...
sentences.zh: 所以我们有一个……

sentences.en: The bill does contain money for Democratic priorities, for programs to address the opioid epidemic, and money for hurricane-ravaged areas like Texas and Puerto Rico.
sentences.zh: 该法案确实包含用于民主党优先事项的资金，用于解决阿片类药物流行问题的项目，以及用于德克萨斯州和波多黎各等饱受飓风摧残地区的资金。

sentences.en: It contains a lot of money, $131 billion, much more than Democrats ever thought they would get.
sentences.zh: 它包含大量资金，高达 1310 亿美元，远超民主党人的预期。

sentences.en: And Nancy Pelosi herself helped negotiate this package.
sentences.zh: 南希·佩洛西本人也参与了这项一揽子计划的谈判。

sentences.en: I mean, Cheryl, that's quite confusing.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，谢丽尔，这太令人困惑了。

sentences.en: If this spending bill contains lots of money for lots of Democratic priorities, and if dozens of House Democrats are going to vote for it and get it
sentences.zh: 如果这项支出法案包含大量针对民主党优先事项的资金，并且如果数十名众议院民主党人将投票赞成并通过它

sentences.en: passed, why is Pelosi spending eight hours on the House floor seemingly in protest of the bill?
sentences.zh: 为什么佩洛西要在众议院大厅花八个小时似乎在抗议这项法案？

sentences.en: I think Nancy Pelosi at this moment is kind of caught in the middle of an identity crisis within the Democratic Party.
sentences.zh: 我认为此时的南希·佩洛西有点陷入了民主党内部的身份认同危机之中。

sentences.en: It's a moment where Democrats are kind of searching their souls for who they are and what does their party stand for.
sentences.zh: 这是一个民主党人正在深刻反思自己是谁以及他们的党派代表什么的时刻。

sentences.en: You've got one wing, the sort of traditional, liberal, Democratic base that's made up of women and people of color and immigrants saying,
sentences.zh: 你有一翼，也就是由女性、有色人种和移民组成的传统、自由派民主党基本盘，他们说：

sentences.en: you know, we are the party of the dreamers.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我们是追梦人的政党。

sentences.en: We're the party that is standing firm for the rights of these young undocumented immigrants to be productive members of American society.
sentences.zh: 我们是坚定捍卫这些年轻无证移民权利的政党，让他们成为美国社会的富有成效的成员。

sentences.en: Members like Luis
sentences.zh: 像路易斯这样的成员

sentences.en: Gutierrez, who is from Illinois, who really is pushing Nancy Pelosi to go even harder and draw a tougher line against Paul Ryan in trying to get a fix for DACA.
sentences.zh: 古铁雷斯来自伊利诺伊州，他确实在敦促南希·佩洛西采取更强硬的立场，在争取修复 DACA 的问题上对保罗·瑞安划出更艰难的底线。

sentences.en: What do you think she accomplished?
sentences.zh: 你认为她取得了什么成就？

sentences.en: It's an eight-hour speech, an empty gesture.
sentences.zh: 这是一场长达八小时的演讲，一个空洞的姿态。

sentences.en: Look, tomorrow you have to put the full weight, right, and power and influence of the Democratic caucus, and she's the leader, right?
sentences.zh: 听着，明天你必须调动民主党党团的全部重量、权利和影响力，对吧，而她是领袖，对吧？

sentences.en: And if she gave that speech, I'm thankful for her for giving that speech.
sentences.zh: 如果她发表了那场演讲，我很感谢她发表了那场演讲。

sentences.en: I have brought her for giving the speech.
sentences.zh: 我支持她发表这一演讲。

sentences.en: And now tomorrow I want her to use the same kind of tenacity and muscle and perseverance to stop the Democrats from folding.
sentences.zh: 现在，明天我希望她能展现出同样的韧性、实力和毅力，阻止民主党人妥协。

sentences.en: To people on the left, people of color are the future of the Democratic Party.
sentences.zh: 对于左翼人士来说，有色人种就是民主党人的未来。

sentences.en: This is the future.
sentences.zh: 这就是未来。

sentences.en: This is the fastest growing segment of the voting population.
sentences.zh: 这是投票人口中增长最快的部分。

sentences.en: And Democrats need to care what immigrants think and what they want.
sentences.zh: 民主党人需要关心移民的想法和诉求。

sentences.en: Everybody was like, oh no, we can't make this about the dreamers.
sentences.zh: 每个人都觉得，哦不，我们不能把这变成关于追梦人的事。

sentences.en: We've got to make it about the chip program.
sentences.zh: 我们得把它变成关于儿童健康保险项目（CHIP）的事。

sentences.en: We've got to make it about the opioid crisis.
sentences.zh: 我们得把它变成关于阿片类药物危机的事。

sentences.en: We've got to make it about infrastructure, right?
sentences.zh: 我们得把它变成关于基础设施的事，对吧？

sentences.en: Guess what?
sentences.zh: 你猜怎么着？

sentences.en: All those things are in the deal.
sentences.zh: 所有这些事情都包含在协议中了。

sentences.en: Here's what I said.
sentences.zh: 我是这么说的。

sentences.en: Watch.
sentences.zh: 看。

sentences.en: Everything we ask for will be included in the grand bargain except immigration.
sentences.zh: 我们要求的一切都会被纳入重大协议中，除了移民问题。

sentences.en: Because immigration is the glue that keeps the Republican Party together.
sentences.zh: 因为移民问题是维系共和党团结的胶水。

sentences.en: Luis Gutierrez said to me, everybody's on this bill except the dreamers.
sentences.zh: 路易斯·古铁雷斯对我说，除了追梦人之外，所有人都包含在这项法案里。

sentences.en: Why is that?
sentences.zh: 为什么会这样？

sentences.en: For Democrats, it's always mañana.
sentences.zh: 对民主党人来说，永远都是明天再说。

sentences.en: But then you've got this other wing of the Democratic Party, people like Tim Ryan, who's a little bit more complicated.
sentences.zh: 但民主党内还有另一派人，比如蒂姆·赖安，情况就稍微复杂一些。

sentences.en: Tim Ryan told me, I'm for the dreamers.
sentences.zh: 蒂姆·赖安对我说，我支持追梦人。

sentences.en: I want to protect the dreamers.
sentences.zh: 我想保护追梦人。

sentences.en: What do you think of what she did yesterday?
sentences.zh: 你对她昨天的做法怎么看？

sentences.en: Well, I think it was important for us to take a stand and at least try to get a vote.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我认为对我们来说，表明立场并至少争取进行表决是很重要的。

sentences.en: I mean, that's all we're asking for.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这正是我们所要求的。

sentences.en: But what I also want and what I need is for the leadership of the party to project that Democrats care about the working class voters, the kind of Trump Democrats, the white
sentences.zh: 但我也想要、而且我需要的是，党内领导层展现出民主党关心工人阶级选民，也就是特朗普式的民主党人、那些白人

sentences.en: working class voters who Democrats lost to President Trump.
sentences.zh: 以及民主党在总统大选中输给特朗普的工人阶级选民。

sentences.en: That's the part of the party that the Tim Ryans of the world need to capture in order to survive.
sentences.zh: 这是世上像蒂姆·赖安这样的人为了生存必须争取的党内群体。

sentences.en: You know, if you're going into a budget battle, you can't go in with just, you know, a million dreamers.
sentences.zh: 你知道，如果要打一场预算战，你不能只靠区区数百万追梦人。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: It's not a big enough coalition.
sentences.zh: 这个联盟还不够大。

sentences.en: You needed the coal miners, the retired coal miners, the retired teamsters saying, everybody who's getting screwed right now, we're here for you.
sentences.zh: 你需要煤矿工人、退休煤矿工人、退休卡车司机站出来说，每一个现在受到不公对待的人，我们都支持你们。

sentences.en: For members like that, every moment that Nancy Pelosi spends talking about immigration and making
sentences.zh: 对于这样的议员来说，南希·佩洛西花在谈论移民问题上的每一刻，以及

sentences.en: the Democratic identity about immigration is a moment that Democrats are not talking about the
sentences.zh: 将民主党的身份定义为移民问题的每一刻，都是民主党没有去谈论

sentences.en: meat and potatoes economic issues that they believe they're going to have to talk about to win the
sentences.zh: 他们认为为了在2018年夺回众议院就必须谈论的

sentences.en: House back in 2018.
sentences.zh: 核心经济议题的时刻。

sentences.en: We have yet to unify the party and the people around a cohesive message.
sentences.zh: 我们还没有围绕一个有凝聚力的信息将党内和民众团结起来。

sentences.en: That's her job, isn't it?
sentences.zh: 那是她的工作，不是吗？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: I mean, you know, between the House and the Senate, you know, we're playing a lot of defense.
sentences.zh: 我是说，你知道的，在众议院和参议院之间，你知道，我们在进行大量的防守。

sentences.en: By standing on the House floor and talking for eight hours about immigrants, Nancy Pelosi was in
sentences.zh: 通过在众议院发言八小时谈论移民，南希·佩洛西

sentences.en: effect stripping that economic message out of the Democratic Party, that what she was doing was really
sentences.zh: 实际上是在剥离民主党经济主张中的这一信息，她所做的事情

sentences.en: eclipsing this broader economic message that Democrats need to have in order to win in 2018.
sentences.zh: 确实盖过了民主党为了在2018年赢得大选所需要阐述的更广泛的经济主张。

sentences.en: I think that in his view, what Pelosi is doing is narrowing the party.
sentences.zh: 我认为在他看来，佩洛西的做法正在让党派的基盘变窄。

sentences.en: And Ryan's view is she needs to be expanding it.
sentences.zh: 而赖安的观点是，她需要扩大基盘。

sentences.en: You know, but we have got to be very aggressive in communicating to people in areas that we haven't
sentences.zh: 你知道，但我们必须非常积极地与我们有一段时间没去过的地方的人们沟通，

sentences.en: gone to in a while and make the case that we're representing those people's interests.
sentences.zh: 并阐明我们代表着这些人的利益。

sentences.en: And we care about them.
sentences.zh: 并且我们在乎他们。

sentences.en: Cheryl, what are the risks for Pelosi and for Democrats in handling the budget situation and the Dreamers in this way, in trying to have it both ways?
sentences.zh: 谢丽尔，佩洛西和民主党人以这种方式处理预算状况和追梦人问题，试图两头兼顾，存在什么风险？

sentences.en: I think there is a risk.
sentences.zh: 我认为确实存在风险。

sentences.en: I think the risk is that you lose both sides, that she claimed to be for the
sentences.zh: 我认为风险在于两头不讨好，她声称自己支持

sentences.en: Dreamers, but she didn't deliver for the Dreamers.
sentences.zh: 追梦人，但她并没有为追梦人兑现承诺。

sentences.en: Democrats claim to be for the Dreamers, but they haven't delivered.
sentences.zh: 民主党人声称支持追梦人，但他们没有兑现。

sentences.en: And on the other side, they spent all this political capital, all this time and energy, bringing the plight of the Dreamers to light, leaving the sort of Trump Democrats to wonder,
sentences.zh: 而在另一边，他们耗费了所有的政治资本、时间和精力，让追梦人的困境大白于天下，却让那些特朗普支持者不禁疑惑，

sentences.en: hey, who's talking about me?
sentences.zh: 嘿，谁在为我发声？

sentences.en: Why aren't they talking about me?
sentences.zh: 为什么他们不谈论我？

sentences.en: And a year and a half after Donald Trump was elected, Democrats are still trying to figure out who they represent.
sentences.zh: 在唐纳德·特朗普当选一年半之后，民主党人仍在试图弄清楚他们代表的是谁。

sentences.en: They're still left struggling to figure out who they're really for and what they're really about.
sentences.zh: 他们依然在挣扎着弄清楚他们真正支持谁以及他们的核心宗旨是什么。

sentences.en: Ultimately, isn't the inability to figure out what a party stands for and who it's advocating for, isn't that what leads parties to fail?
sentences.zh: 归根结底，无法弄清楚一个政党代表什么以及它在为什么人争取利益，这不正是导致政党失败的原因吗？

sentences.en: That is what leads parties to fail, and it's the job of the leader to figure that out.
sentences.zh: 这确实是导致政党失败的原因，而领导人的职责就是弄清楚这一点。

sentences.en: Cheryl, thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢丽尔，谢谢你。

sentences.en: Thanks, Michael.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，迈克尔。

sentences.en: Now that there is an agreement on long-term government funding, the Senate will proceed to a fair debate over the DACA issue, border security, and other matters pertaining to the
sentences.zh: 既然在长期政府拨款问题上已经达成一致，参议院将继续就DACA问题、边境安全以及其他与

sentences.en: subject of immigration.
sentences.zh: 移民主题相关的事宜展开公平辩论。

sentences.en: This process begins in just a few hours.
sentences.zh: 这个进程将在短短几个小时后开始。

sentences.en: On Monday, as promised to his Democratic colleagues in exchange for ending the government shutdown three
sentences.zh: 周一，正如他向民主党同僚承诺的那样，作为三周前同意结束政府关门的交换条件，

sentences.en: weeks ago, Senate Majority Leader Mitch McConnell began a rare, open-ended debate over immigration
sentences.zh: 参议院多数党领袖米奇·麦康奈尔开启了一场罕见的、不限时的主题辩论，聚焦移民

sentences.en: and the DREAMers, a process that will allow senators to build a bill from scratch on the Senate floor.
sentences.zh: 与追梦人，这一进程将允许参议员们在参议院大厅从零开始起草一项法案。

sentences.en: I hope this body can seize this opportunity and deliver real progress towards securing our border,
sentences.zh: 我希望这个机构能够抓住这个机会，在保障我们的边境安全、

sentences.en: reforming aspects of immigration policy, and achieving a resolution for individuals who were brought to our country illegally when they were young.
sentences.zh: 改革移民政策的各方面以及为年轻时被非法带到我们国家的人找到解决方案方面，取得真正的进展。

sentences.en: If the Senate adopts a bill extending protections for DREAMers, the legislation would then move on to the House, where its fate is far less certain.
sentences.zh: 如果参议院通过一项延长对追梦人保护的法案，该立法随后将提交至众议院，而其命运在那里则远不确定。

sentences.en: Legal protections for tens of thousands of DREAMers will expire in three weeks.
sentences.zh: 数万名追梦人的法律保护将在三周后到期。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Hey, I'm Benjamin Poulin.
sentences.zh: 嘿，我是本杰明·普兰。

sentences.en: And I'm Mark Ronson.
sentences.zh: 我是马克·罗森。

sentences.en: And welcome to The Reframers, a podcast that's all about the love of design and the culture that surrounds it.
sentences.zh: 欢迎收听《重构者》，这是一个专注于设计之美及其周边文化的播客。

sentences.en: Even back when I was DJing in nightclubs, in the era of vinyl, every night, you took 300 of your most prized possessions to work with you,
sentences.zh: 甚至在我还在夜店当DJ的黑胶唱片时代，每晚你都要带着300件你最珍视的宝贝去上班，

sentences.en: and you turned a DJ booth into this, like, living pop-up museum of beautiful 50-year-old artifacts.
sentences.zh: 把DJ台变成一个像是由精美50年历史艺术品组成的、充满活力的快闪博物馆。

sentences.en: Listen to The Reframers from Audemars Piguet now on your favorite podcast platforMs.
sentences.zh: 立即在你喜爱的播客平台上收听来自爱彼的《重构者》。

sentences.en: Subscribe to The New York Times, download The Times app today, and get free access for 30 days.
sentences.zh: 订阅《纽约时报》，立即下载《时报》应用程序，即可免费畅享30天。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还需要了解的其他新闻。

sentences.en: On Monday, President Trump released his proposal for next year's federal budget, a plan that would deeply cut spending for public housing, food stamps, Medicare, Medicaid,
sentences.zh: 周一，特朗普总统发布了他对明年联邦预算的提案，该计划将大幅削减公共住房、食品券、联邦医疗保险、医疗补助

sentences.en: and health care subsidies, while heavily increasing spending on the military and border security.
sentences.zh: 和医疗保健补贴的开支，同时大幅增加军费和边境安全开支。

sentences.en: The Times reports that the proposal has little chance of being enacted as written, but amounts to a statement of values by the president.
sentences.zh: 《时报》报道称，该提案按原样通过的可能性很小，但它代表了总统的价值观声明。

sentences.en: By the White House's own estimate, the budget would add $984 billion to next year's federal deficit, and $7 trillion to the deficit over the next decade.
sentences.zh: 根据白宫自己的估计，该预算将在明年的联邦赤字中增加9840亿美元，并在未来十年内增加7万亿美元的赤字。

sentences.en: That's it for The Daily.
sentences.zh: 以上就是本期《每日新闻》的全部内容。

sentences.en: I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: See you tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 我们明天见。

sentences.en: For decades, the Brooklyn Democratic Party operated as a tightly controlled machine.
sentences.zh: 几十年来，布鲁克林民主党一直作为一个受严密控制的机器在运作。

sentences.en: Until this summer.
sentences.zh: 直到今年夏天。

sentences.en: When elections ushered in a bunch of self-described reformers.
sentences.zh: 当时选举迎来了数十位自诩为改革派的人士。

sentences.en: Ever since, the party has been in the grip of a bruising, chaotic, and sometimes thrilling fight.
sentences.zh: 从那以后，该党就陷入了一场激烈、混乱且有时令人兴奋的权力斗争中。

sentences.en: In the latest episode of Metro, with me, Sarah Koenig, stories of people trying to maintain their influence and losing control along the way.
sentences.zh: 在由我萨拉·科尼格主持的最新一期《都市》节目中，我们将讲述人们试图维持自身影响力却在过程中逐渐失控的故事。

sentences.en: Metro.
sentences.zh: 《都市》。

sentences.en: Listen wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 请在各大播客平台收听。
